opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award, with teaching and admin duties, based at a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Up to two Co-applicants (different Academy remit) eligible.
opportunities.summary: Offers established independent researchers the opportunity to pursue genuine interdisciplinary and curiosity-driven research across the boundaries of science, engineering, and the social sciences and humanities, in partnership with the Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering and Leverhulme Trust.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call; no prior British Academy funding required. Previous successful recipients of this award are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Supports ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a gallery, archive, library or museum or a performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs. Seed funding available for collaborations.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany, from the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Invites early career researchers to attend a research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', bringing together around fifteen early career researchers from the UK and fifteen from Germany.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: Three-year award under FEC regime; Academy funds 80 per cent of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible regardless of doctorate origin; anyone with a UK doctorate eligible; Viva Voce completed between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027; must not have held a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship offering outstanding early-career researchers the opportunity to complete a significant piece of publishable research and integrate into the community of established scholars in their field.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO continuing for the full duration of the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas (quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities, languages) to develop current and future research, including interdisciplinary approaches.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: Up to £300,000 over 2 years at 80% FEC (total project value at 100% FEC may not exceed £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute in an established role lasting the duration of the award, of postdoctoral or above status, spending at least 20% time on the award. Co-Applicants based overseas required.
opportunities.summary: Supports genuinely interdisciplinary international research projects led by and grounded in the humanities and/or social sciences on the theme of Mobilities, collaborating across SHAPE and STEM disciplines.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: Awards for up to £150,000 for 12 months in duration (Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to two one-year fellowships hosted in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, enabling SHAPE researchers to develop skills, networks and careers in policy and other sectors, producing policy-relevant analysis for German decision-makers.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: Funding of up to £4,000; exceptional cases above £4,000 considered

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders OR applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months who need support with submitting their application.
opportunities.summary: Provides additional funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require (e.g. equipment to overcome barriers for disabled researchers, assistance for sensory impairments, caring costs for research trips, support to make an application). Offered on a rolling deadline.
